_comment: Prices that move with the story. See src/core/prices.gd. Named prices are what dialogue charges for one thing; markets scale traders' prices for some goods while their conditions hold.

brig_line._comment: Striking Brigodunon's line from the house of Vettius's book. Cheap while the house is only buying futures; ten times dearer once the Aedui take Noviodunum and the forward sale is real; gone at Alesia.

markets._comment: Gergovia under siege: food and medicine cost what wine used to.
